name: Matrix Sum Invertibility Isomorphism
description: Replaces the recognizable Pauli matrix anti-commutation rule with a novel local matrix-sum determinant rule. The new matrices $C_1$ and $C_2$ are constructed such that $C_1+C_1$ and $C_2+C_2$ are singular, while $C_1+C_2$ is invertible. This forces models to manually evaluate the pairwise combinations instead of relying on memorized quantum physics facts about Pauli matrices, successfully hiding the 2-coloring reduction from surface pattern matchers while preserving the exact edge-wise constraint structure.
